name: Todd Wilderman
bio: Todd Wilderman (born June 9, 1973) is an American animation director, writer, story artist, and animator who has spent over 25 years working with major Hollywood animation studios like Sony Pictures Imageworks, DreamWorks Animation, and Warner Bros. Animation.

credits.title: Daffy Season
credits.overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

credits.title: Almost Home
credits.overview: A group of aliens searching for a new planet on which to make home, with little success. Promotional short for Dreamworks Animation's forthcoming feature, Home.
